title: Prospective study registry for the systematic collection of clinical and epidemiological data of patients at the Interdisciplinary Women's Heart Center of the Department of Internal Medicine I at the University Hospital RWTH Aachen
summary: Cardiovascular diseases represent the leading cause of death worldwide. While the significance of typical risk factors such as high cholesterol levels or smoking in the development of cardiovascular diseases is now well established, the importance of sex-specific factors in this context has so far been insufficiently considered. Consequently, substantial inequalities between men and women persist in the diagnosis, treatment, and research of cardiovascular diseases. The aim of our study is to establish a long-term data collection that systematically records medically relevant patient data. This is intended to facilitate the research of female-specific aspects of disease. All female patients presenting to the Interdisciplinary Women's Heart Center of the Department of Internal Medicine I at the University Hospital RWTH Aachen are asked during regular clinic hours whether their data may be stored in the study registry for future studies.
conditions: 1. Establishment of a prospective registry study for the systematic collection of clinical and epidemiological data from patients attending the interdisciplinary Women's Heart Center of the Department of Internal Medicine I at RWTH Aachen University Hospital.  2. Facilitation of future clinical, biomedical, and health services research projects through the creation of a comprehensive and structured database.  3. Assessment of disease-specific aspects and the development of organizational structures aimed at optimizing the multidisciplinary coordination of diagnostic and therapeutic pathways in women's healthcare.
